audit_metadata.title: Independent Reproducibility Audit: Wearable ECG Stress Detection with Relative Baseline Normalization and M-4DCHS Telemetry Obfuscation
audit_metadata.execution_mode: Strict Verification & Code-Truth Audit (Table IV Synchronized & Hardware Stress Tested)

evidence_classification_definitions.MEASURED: Directly executed and observed from source code / hardware during this audit run
evidence_classification_definitions.CALCULATED: Derived through verified closed-form mathematical equations from measured data
evidence_classification_definitions.ESTIMATED: Derived from analytical models or hardware architecture assumptions (e.g., cycle counts from MAC counts)
evidence_classification_definitions.REPORTED: Values stated in manuscript/documentation not directly re-computed dynamically by standalone code
evidence_classification_definitions.NOT_VERIFIED: Could not be verified directly during the session with exact rationale provided

phase_1_dataset_and_windowing.note_on_subject_ids: S12 does not exist in standard WESAD distribution; 15 subjects total (S2-S17 without S12)

window_counts_by_condition.baseline_per_subject: Exactly 19 windows per subject across all 15 subjects

phase_2_feature_extraction.audit_note: Reconciled: Exactly 13 physiological features exist in expanded CSV matching manuscript Section III-B. Frequency domain features (LF, HF) were previously misreported in audit text and are not part of this time-domain pipeline.

protocol.reference_centroid: Computed strictly from the resting baseline windows (Label = 1) of subject s
protocol.data_leakage_safeguard_1: Test stress windows (Label = 2) are never used in computing B_s
protocol.data_leakage_safeguard_2: StandardScaler is fit strictly on training folds (N-1 subjects) and applied out-of-fold to held-out test subject

exploratory_sensitivity_prioritized_poin.classification_nature: TEST-SET TUNED / EXPLORATORY (POST-HOC SWEEP ACROSS POOLED PREDICTIONS)

phase_5_decision_threshold_analysis.audit_distinction_confirmed: Paper correctly distinguishes between pre-specified tau=0.50 primary result and exploratory swept tau=0.35 operating point

like_for_like_13_feature_ablation_gain.comparison: Stage M3 (Uncalibrated 13 Features) vs Stage M4 (Calibrated 13 Features) at tau = 0.50

primary_8_feature_vs_uncalibrated_baseli.comparison: Stage M3 (Uncalibrated 13 Features) vs Primary Model (Calibrated 8 Features) at tau = 0.50

phase_8_explainability_and_odds_ratios.method: 30-repeat Permutation Importance over 15 LOSO Held-Out Folds
phase_8_explainability_and_odds_ratios.redundancy_notes: MeanHR and MeanRR exhibit inverse collinearity (HR = 60/RR); RR_CV is derived as SDNN / MeanRR

S2.clinical_rationale: Blunted autonomic cardiac reactivity under TSST protocol; baseline HR remained unchanged

S10.clinical_rationale: Resting tachycardia (~95 BPM baseline); global models fail, but relative baseline calibration perfectly classifies both calm and stress

architecture.type: Custom C Direct Form I Biquad IIR Cascade
architecture.cmsis_status: CMSIS-DF1 algorithmically equivalent, implemented natively in C for portability

causal_c_iir_vs_offline_zero_phase_filtf.parity_finding: Expected causal phase lag and group delay (~10 samples) fully account for numerical difference from offline acausal filtfilt

computational_cost.audit_finding: Estimated based on 5 MACs per biquad section on Cortex-M4 single-precision FPU. Not directly measured using DWT CYCCNT during this session.

jacobian_trace_divergence.dissipation_status: Strictly dissipative everywhere in R^4 (volume contraction rate = -39/s)

lyapunov_spectrum_numerical_verification.solver: Variational RK4 + continuous QR Gram-Schmidt reorthogonalization

regime_classification.reason: Does not possess two positive Lyapunov exponents. lambda_1 = +0.000639 represents near-zero neutral along-trajectory flow. System is strongly dissipative converging to a low-dimensional attractor.
regime_classification.paper_consistency: Paper correctly documents spectrum and disclaims hyperchaotic regime

synchronized_hash_constant.status: Synchronized across Python, C firmware, and manuscript Eq. 25-26

chi_square_uniformity.verdict: Passes uniformity test with high statistical confidence

computational_overhead.audit_finding: Cycle count is an analytical estimate for Cortex-M4 single-precision arithmetic without transcendentals. Not directly measured using DWT CYCCNT.

phase_18_19_python_c_parity.framing_and_crc_parity: 100.0% bit-exact framing, status flags, and CRC-16 generation between Python and STM32 C implementations
phase_18_19_python_c_parity.filter_parity: Causal single-precision C IIR matches Python lfilter output within float32 precision; phase lag relative to offline filtfilt is expected and confirmed
phase_18_19_python_c_parity.parity_scope_clarification: The directly verified Python <-> C parity applies to framing, packet headers, status flags, CRC-16 computation, and IIR filtering. Physical hardware streams in 32-bit scrambler mode (flags=0x01). M-4DCHS encryption/decryption statistical metrics are verified in software on 10,000 packets; on-chip bit-exact M4D ciphertext parity against physical MCU was not verified because the active firmware build uses mode 1.

phase_20_21_physical_hardware_hil.hardware_claim_reproducibility: The manuscript claim of >15,000 consecutive packets with 0 CRC errors and 0 frame drops is now DIRECTLY AND INDEPENDENTLY REPRODUCED on physical hardware (15,515 packets captured at 350.84 Hz with 0 CRC errors and 0 drops).

final_verdict.summary: Every single machine learning benchmark, cross-validation split, feature extraction routine, statistical encryption test, dynamical system simulation, and physical serial telemetry transaction runs cleanly from source code and reproduces reported numbers with bit-exact or sub-tolerance mathematical fidelity. Table IV has been fully synchronized in paper/main.tex. The 15,000-frame hardware streaming benchmark was freshly captured on COM10 (15,515 frames, 0 CRC errors, 0 drops). Python/C parity scope is strictly documented. Demo UI terminology has been completely sanitized.
